project_git.strategy: Full reachable history with --full-history, first tracked path addition, then exact Git blob reads; no generated index used as file inventory.

tracked_alias_evidence.scope: Historical path/name correspondence, not original adaptation revision proof.

retained_operator_history.privacy: No operator paths, identifiers, command transcripts, conversation text or credentials are redistributed.

scope.exhaustion_boundary: The finding is scoped to surviving project Git objects, local source clones/reflogs, tracked alias records and retained operator history inspected here. It does not assert that external backups or upstream contribution records cannot contain additional evidence.

separate_review_observations.observation_kind: Retained operator evidence documents a successful fixed archive listing and document/frontmatter review; raw operator records are not redistributed.

integrity_and_limits: Initial local commits and blobs are immutable public project Git objects; candidate commits, paths, Git blobs and SHA-256 values came from historical clone objects read locally.
Private operator reflog fingerprints document the inspected evidence; they are not publicly retrievable attestations of read activity.
Fixed URLs are object-addressed citations, not a claim that each remote object remains accessible indefinitely.
No source skill code or instructions were executed; no network fetch/pull was used for this investigation.
